author: AstroBlue
what_it_is: EEPROM Save: All 120 Stars and 2000+ Coins collected.
format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak (PAL notes ND4P, NPDP with no pages) with a GameShark cart-save note "SMSM" ext 1, 2 pages = the 4 Kbit EEPROM

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert super-mario-64.1173.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header; cart-save note 'SMSM' (GameShark 3BADD1E5/FADE): raw EEPROM, 512 bytes

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save the PAL game opens on its SOUND SELECT / LANGUAGE SELECT screen
